featured_techniques.technique: Congruence of heart and habit as the backbone of the organization
Habit as translation of decisions into organizational action
Blending commerce with humanity to guide decision making

concepts: aligning decisions with customers and employees
sections.description: Jean Bliss introduces the idea that beloved companies earn loyalty by making decisions that move toward customers and employees, prompting them to advocate for the brand and seek it out over competitors.
sections.title: Premise: Beloved Companies and Loyalty

concepts: culture as the compass of decision making
fork in the road: decisions for others vs internal agendas
sections.description: The speaker links culture to decision direction, noting that at key forks, choosing the path that serves customers and employees (over self-interest) supports long-term prosperity. Congruence of heart and habit becomes the backbone of the Beloved Company.
sections.title: Culture as Compass: Heart, Habit, and the Fork in the Road

sections.description: Habit is described as the mechanism by which decisions become everyday actions across the organization, shaping the customer experience through coordinated internal behavior.
sections.title: Habit as Translation of Decisions

concepts: growth when customers love what you do and how you do it
sections.description: Bliss argues that the decisions and values inside a beloved company define what customers perceive and value. When customers love the firm, they become storytellers and growth drivers.
sections.title: Impact: Values, Story, and Growth through Love

summary: In this short talk, Jeanne Bliss explains how beloved companies earn extraordinary customer loyalty by making decisions that prioritize customers and employees, blending commerce with humanity, and aligning culture with actions. The content emphasizes the concept of congruence between heart (culture) and habit (actions), the way internal choices at critical forks steer outcomes, and how everyday decisions become the unified experience customers encounter. When customers love how you do business, they effectively become advocates who help grow the company.
title: Beloved Companies: How Culture and Heart Translate Decisions into Customer Growth
topics: growth driven by love and trust
